description: Returns the skewness of a distribution: a characterization of the degree of asymmetry of a distribution around its mean.

params.description: Up to 255 numeric values for which the skewness of a distribution will be returned.The first argument is required, subsequent arguments are optional. Arguments can be numbers, names, ranges, or arrays of numbers.
params.name: args

signature: SKEW(args: number | ApiName | number[] | ApiRange): number
